item.description:
• Renaming with your own key now stays on your own key. If the key or endpoint is misconfigured, Nymos tells you instead of quietly finishing the job another way.
  • Audio and video files are named from their metadata again, instead of being skipped.
  • Changing your model re-opens the files it skipped, so you can name them straight away.
  • A provider rate limit now slows a batch down instead of stopping it, and a limit that will not clear ends the run with a clear message rather than waiting forever.
  • OpenRouter and custom endpoints keep their own model setting, and a model that reads images is recognised as one.
  • Local models over http can connect.
  • Fixes to the AI settings tab: the connection status no longer shows the previous provider's result, and "Change model…" from the skip dialog now opens Settings.

• Use your own AI provider. Connect your own account at one of nine providers, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and rename on your own key. A new AI tab in Settings holds the setup, and a one-time lifetime licence is available in the app.
  • On a nymos subscription, documents are now processed in the European Union.
  • More formats, 57 in all: OpenDocument, Pages, Numbers and Keynote, plus audio and video named from the details the file carries.
  • Batches cope with limits. Files your model cannot read are flagged before the run and skipped rather than failing it, and a rate limit now waits and resumes instead of ending the batch.
  • A redrawn Settings window and new typefaces throughout the app.
  • Fixes: a locked keychain no longer starts a fresh trial, Command-Q quits with a sheet open, and the status pill appears only while a run is actually happening.
• The app icon is now the same size as other apps in the Dock.
